title: Cosmic Banana Dog
description: A large green dog with a banana-patterned pink collar stands in profile, gazing toward a red Buddha-like figure stirring a bubbling green cauldron on a small island. The surreal night scene features a starry galaxy sky, a crescent moon with a hooded figure, a multi-armed sun deity, and countless floating bananas on the water and shore.
prompt: Psychedelic surreal painting of a giant vibrant green dog wearing a pink banana-patterned collar, standing in profile and staring at a small red Buddha figure stirring a cauldron of glowing green liquid. The cauldron sits on a fiery island in a swirling blue pond covered with floating bananas. Background shows a cosmic starry sky with galaxies, a crescent moon with a hooded figure, and a multi-armed golden sun deity. Highly detailed, vibrant colors, mystical atmosphere.
